_doc: Typographic pass (referee-adjudication skill): one reviewer per page range is asked to look at every page image
of its range. Render the images first with render_pages.sh, one directory per unit, e.g. <images>/img-1-60.
Each report is saved as <workdir>/<unit>/inspect/typography.md: the sources consulted, a defects table, and a
last line 'Clean pages: ...'. Then run writing-workflow's check_coverage.py --pages <first>-<last> on each
report: a page in neither the table nor the clean-pages line was not reported as inspected. The same shape, with
exposition-reviewer.md, the snapshot's sources in the packet and require '(?m)^\W*Renamings:', runs the
exposition reviews of an editorial pass. Copy this file to <working repository>/rollout/, replace every SET-ME

vars.pdf: SET-ME: the compiled PDF of the frozen release candidate
vars.images: SET-ME: the directory holding one image directory per page range (render_pages.sh -o)
